main_subject.detail: A centered white mystery car silhouette with three large red-and-blue outlined question marks over it, placed on a glowing folded blue ribbon platform. Large stacked headline above reads 'Mini Game', 'NHIN HINH DOAN TEN', 'QUA XIN CHO BAN', followed by the exact date line 'TU 16.06.2026 - 30.06.2026'. Four big answer cards fill the lower half with labels A, B, C, D and the exact options 'BAO HIEM DAN SU XE MAY', 'BAO HIEM DAN SU XE O TO', 'BAO HIEM TAI NAN XE O TO', 'BAO HIEM TAI NAN'. Bottom CTA pill reads 'THAM GIA NGAY'.
